BETA Close X Barratt Redrow plc has purchased 1,860,000 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £386 million share repurchase program, with transactions occurring between September 1 and September 4, 2026, on the London Stock Exchange. The volume-weighted average price paid per share during this period was approximately 307.05 pence. Following these purchases, Barratt Redrow holds no shares in treasury, and its total issued ordinary shares stand at 1,393,038,419, resulting in an equal number of voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 07 September 2026 7 September 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 1 September 2026 to 4 September 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Date of Purchase within Disclosure Period Aggregate volume (shares) Highest price paid per share (pence) Lowest price paid per share (pence) Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence) Trading venue 01 Sep 2026 468,000 318.4000 308.3000 312.2426 LSE 02 Sep 2026 468,000 314.0000 304.5000 308.1214 LSE 03 Sep 2026 468,000 305.5000 297.7000 302.3595 LSE 04 Sep 2026 468,000 309.2000 301.6000 305.6955 LSE To date, Barratt Redrow has purchased 17,481,834 ordinary shares in aggregate for cancellation from Barclays in accordance with the Buyback Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,393,038,419 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,393,038,419.
